grader: Claude Opus 5.5 (evaluating agent), scripted ceiling, graded before any live call

authorship.rationale: Cites only Observations and attributes nothing to an Interpretation or the steward.

claims.rationale: A reading: A:1 and A:5 give reasons for a vigil, A:2 that it goes unexplained.
A:1 and A:2 state that the lamp burned all night and no one asked why.
A reading for which A:5 (a second lamp deliberately lit) gives a specific reason.

intent.rationale: Takes a position (vigil) on the asked question and gives reasons from A:1, A:2 and A:5.

uncertainty.rationale: No open matter is asserted as an event or cause; who lit the lamps and why stay open.

authorship.rationale: Readings are attributed to the steward; the accepted model contribution I3 is not used.

claims.rationale: I1, I2 and A:4 together give reasons; framed as read through the steward's interpretations.
Adopts I1 with attribution to the steward; A:1 is the cited Observation.
Adopts I2 with attribution; A:6 and A:3 bear on the unrecorded vigil.
A:4 states the empty harbor; the limit (what left or why is unsaid) is true.

intent.rationale: Builds an argument about what the lamp means for the harbor from the steward's I1 and I2.

uncertainty.rationale: What left the harbor and why are stated as unknown; vigil appears only as the steward's reading.
